text.autoconnect.cloth.description: Controls when AutoConnect should join a server, which server it uses, and whether failed joins should be retried.
text.autoconnect.config.description: Controls when AutoConnect joins a server and how failed joins are retried.
text.autoconnect.enabled.description: When enabled, opening Multiplayer starts one automatic connection attempt.
text.autoconnect.last_server.none: Last connected server: none remembered yet.
text.autoconnect.retry_count.description: Additional attempts after the first failed connection.
text.autoconnect.retry_count.example: For example, 2 means the first attempt plus two retries.
text.autoconnect.retry_delay_seconds.des: 0 means retry as soon as the disconnect screen opens.
text.autoconnect.retry_delay_seconds.too: Seconds to wait before an automatic retry on the disconnect screen.
text.autoconnect.retry_on_failure.descri: When enabled, AutoConnect retries automatically from the disconnect screen.
text.autoconnect.retry_on_failure.toolti: Controls whether AutoConnect should try again after a failed connection.
text.autoconnect.server_address.blank: Leave blank to skip auto-connect until a server is configured.
